description: Updates an existing Stripe promotion code by setting the values of the parameters passed. Use when you need to activate/deactivate a promotion code, update its metadata, or modify redemption restrictions. Most promotion code fields are intentionally non-editable after creation.

inputSchema.description:
Request model for updating an existing Stripe promotion code.
Only include fields that need to be modified; unspecified fields will remain unchanged.

active.description: Whether the promotion code is currently active. Set to true to reactivate (requires a valid coupon and redeemable status), or false to deactivate.
active.title: Active

id.description: The ID of the promotion code to update.
id.title: Id

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured information. Keys can be up to 40 characters, values up to 500 characters. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value.
metadata.title: Metadata

restrictions.description: Settings controlling promotion code redemption conditions.

additionalProperties.description: Currency-specific minimum amount for promotion code redemption.

minimum_amount.description: Minimum order amount required to redeem the promotion code in this currency. Amount is in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD).
minimum_amount.title: Minimum Amount

additionalProperties.title: CurrencyOptions

currency_options.description: Promotion code definitions per currency using three-letter ISO currency codes as keys. Each currency can have its own minimum_amount requirement.
currency_options.title: Currency Options

restrictions.title: Restrictions

inputSchema.title: UpdatePromotionCodeRequest

name: update_promotion_code

Coupon.description: A coupon contains information about a percent-off or amount-off discount.

amount_off.description: Amount that will be taken off the subtotal of any invoices for this customer.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO code for the currency of the amount to take off.
currency.title: Currency

duration.description: One of forever, once, and repeating. Describes how long a customer who applies this coupon will get the discount.
duration.title: Duration

duration_in_months.description: If duration is repeating, the number of months the coupon applies.
duration_in_months.title: Duration In Months

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

max_redemptions.description: Maximum number of times this coupon can be redeemed, in total, across all customers, before it is no longer valid.
max_redemptions.title: Max Redemptions

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: Name of the coupon displayed to customers on invoices or receipts.
name.title: Name

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'coupon'.
object.title: Object

percent_off.description: Percent that will be taken off the subtotal of any invoices for this customer for the duration of the coupon.
percent_off.title: Percent Off

redeem_by.description: Date after which the coupon can no longer be redeemed.
redeem_by.title: Redeem By

times_redeemed.description: Number of times this coupon has been applied to a customer.
times_redeemed.title: Times Redeemed

valid.description: Taking account of the above properties, whether this coupon can still be applied to a customer.
valid.title: Valid
